footer.tagline: One fitness passport for every city. Members book any partner gym in local currency. Owners fill quiet hours without building their own tech.

hero.title: One pass. <accent>Every gym</accent> on the planet.
hero.lead: Your fitness passport. Land in any city, see which gyms are quiet, book a pass in local currency and walk in with a QR. Every visit adds a stamp.

departures.title: Wherever you land, your pass already works.
departures.lead: Prices stay in each city’s own currency. Times, distances and numbers follow your region.

orbit.title: Gyms around you, <accent>not in a list</accent>
orbit.lead: Closer gyms sit nearer the centre. Each ring fills with how busy it is right now, so the quiet one is easy to spot.

passportSection.title: Every workout leaves <accent>a stamp</accent>
passportSection.lead: Your history goes everywhere with you. One profile, one streak and one QR for every partner gym on the planet.

stamp.title: A stamp per city
stamp.text: Check in once and the city lands in your passport for good.

streak.title: Streaks that travel
streak.text: Your weekly streak keeps counting in any city, on any pass.

perks.title: Perks for regulars
perks.text: Partner gyms reward full passports with free sessions and gear.

pulse.title: Skip the queue for <accent>the squat rack</accent>

live.title: Live crowd
live.text: Every gym reports how full it is as members check in.

forecast.title: Hourly forecast
forecast.text: See the quiet windows for today in the gym’s own time zone.

alerts.title: Quiet alerts
alerts.text: Get a nudge when your favourite gym drops below half full.

twoSides.title: Where people who train meet the gyms that <accent>want them</accent>
twoSides.lead: Fit Planet is a two-sided marketplace. Members get freedom and transparency. Gyms get demand, tools and data they never had.

ex001.description: The king of chest exercises. A compound movement that builds overall chest mass and strength.
ex001.s1: Lie on a flat bench with your feet firmly on the ground
ex001.s2: Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width
ex001.s3: Unrack the bar and lower it to your mid-chest
ex001.s4: Press the bar back up to the starting position
ex001.s5: Keep your back slightly arched and shoulder blades retracted
ex001.t1: Don't bounce the bar off your chest
ex001.t3: Drive through your heels for stability

ex002.description: Targets the upper chest for a fuller, more defined look.
ex002.s2: Hold dumbbells at shoulder level with palms facing forward
ex002.s3: Press dumbbells up until arms are extended
ex002.s4: Lower with control to starting position

ex003.description: A fundamental bodyweight exercise for chest, shoulders, and triceps.
ex003.s1: Start in a plank position with hands shoulder-width apart
ex003.s2: Lower your body until chest nearly touches the floor
ex003.s3: Push back up to starting position
ex003.s4: Keep your body in a straight line throughout

ex004.description: The ultimate back exercise for building width and strength.
ex004.s1: Hang from bar with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width
ex004.s2: Pull yourself up until chin is above the bar
ex004.s3: Lower with control to full arm extension

ex005.description: A compound movement that builds back thickness and strength.
ex005.s1: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, bend at hips
ex005.s2: Grip barbell with hands shoulder-width apart
ex005.s3: Pull bar to lower chest/upper abdomen
ex005.s4: Lower with control, keep back flat

ex006.description: A machine-based exercise great for beginners to build lat width.
ex006.s1: Sit at lat pulldown machine, grab bar with wide grip
ex006.s2: Pull bar down to upper chest
ex006.s3: Squeeze shoulder blades together at bottom
ex006.s4: Return with control to starting position

ex007.description: The primary compound movement for building shoulder strength.
ex007.s3: Press bar overhead until arms are fully extended
ex007.s4: Lower with control to starting position

ex008.description: Isolation exercise that targets the side deltoids for width.
ex008.s1: Stand with dumbbells at your sides
ex008.s2: Raise arms out to the sides until parallel to floor

ex009.description: The king of leg exercises. Builds overall lower body mass.
ex009.s3: Squat down until thighs are parallel to floor
ex009.s4: Drive through heels to stand back up

ex010.description: Targets hamstrings and glutes with a hip-hinge movement.
ex010.s2: Hinge at hips, pushing them back
ex010.s3: Lower bar along legs until you feel hamstring stretch
ex010.s4: Drive hips forward to return to start

ex011.description: Machine-based leg exercise safe for beginners.
ex011.s1: Sit in leg press machine with feet shoulder-width on platform
ex011.s2: Lower the weight by bending knees to 90 degrees
ex011.s3: Press through feet to extend legs
ex011.s4: Don't lock out knees at the top

ex012.description: Classic bicep builder for arm mass.
ex012.s1: Stand with feet shoulder-width, hold barbell with underhand grip
ex012.s2: Curl bar up to shoulder level
ex012.s3: Keep elbows stationary at your sides

ex013.description: Cable exercise that isolates the triceps.
ex013.s1: Stand facing cable machine with rope attachment
ex013.s3: Push rope down until arms are fully extended

ex014.description: Isometric core exercise that builds stability.
ex014.s2: Keep body in straight line from head to heels

ex015.description: Weighted ab exercise for progressive overload.
ex015.s1: Kneel in front of cable machine with rope attachment
ex015.s3: Crunch down, bringing elbows toward knees

ex016.description: Classic cardio for endurance and calorie burn.
ex016.s2: Gradually increase speed to running pace
ex016.s3: Maintain steady pace for desired duration

ex017.description: Full-body cardio that's easy on the joints.

legal.privacyIntro: What we collect when you use Fit Planet, why, who sees it, and how you stay in control.
legal.termsIntro: The rules for booking gym passes, training and sharing on Fit Planet.

privacy.dataText: Download a copy of everything Fit Planet stores about you: profile, bookings, visits, training log and social activity.
privacy.deleteText: Your profile, posts, training log and photos are erased for good. Reviews stay on the gym's page without your name.
privacy.blockedGym: You manage a gym on Fit Planet. Close or hand over your gym before deleting this account.
privacy.blockedPass: You have a pass that is still active or coming up. Cancel it, or wait until it ends, then delete your account.

seo.title: Fit Planet · One pass for every gym on the planet
seo.description: Find gyms in any city, see how busy they are, book day, week or month passes in local currency and walk in with a QR code. Gym owners get bookings and check-ins in one studio.

errorPage.notFoundTitle: This page isn't on the map
errorPage.notFoundText: The link may be old, or the gym may have left Fit Planet. Find another gym nearby instead.
errorPage.errorText: We couldn't load this page. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back in a few minutes.
